tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the supplement categories that currently hold priced products, each with a live product count, store count, lowest normalized unit price, and its comparison basis (per_kg / per_serving / per_capsule). Use this to discover a valid category_slug for find_cheapest.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full detail for one product by its id: price, normalized unit price, size, bulk/staffel tiers, buy link, and recent price history. Use the id returned by find_cheapest or search_products.
